skill.name: brainstorming
skill.description: Collaborative design exploration that refines ideas into validated specs through iterative questioning. Use before any creative work including creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior.
skill.summary: Guides collaborative brainstorming into validated feature designs and implementation-ready specs.
skill.author: CodingCossack

content.value_statement: Early ideas often lack enough detail for confident implementation. This skill guides structured questions, trade-off analysis, and design validation before work begins.
actual_capabilities: Checks current project context before shaping a design.
Asks one focused question at a time to refine ideas.
Compares two or three implementation approaches with trade-offs.
Presents design sections for incremental user validation.
Covers architecture, components, data flow, errors, and testing.
Can document the approved design for later implementation.
limitations: It depends on user answers for ambiguous product goals.
It does not implement the design by itself.
It may need access to project files for accurate context.
It does not replace security, legal, or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Clarify a Product Feature
use_cases.description: A product manager can turn a rough feature idea into clear requirements and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Plan a Technical Change
use_cases.description: An engineer can compare architecture options before changing components, data flow, or behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare Implementation Handoff
use_cases.description: A team lead can create an approved design document before assigning build work.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a New Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a feature or workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me brainstorm this idea into a design: [idea]. Ask one question at a time and start with the most important unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Explore two or three approaches for [feature]. Explain trade-offs, recommend one option, and ask what I want to validate next.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Notes Into a Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these notes to draft a design for [project area]. Validate each section before continuing: [notes].

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Implementation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed design for gaps in architecture, data flow, error handling, and testing. Ask targeted questions before finalizing it: [design].

output_examples.input: I want to add saved filters to our dashboard.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks who owns filters, how sharing should work, and which filter state must persist before proposing design options.

output_examples.input: We need a better onboarding flow.
output_examples.output: The assistant compares guided setup, checklist onboarding, and progressive prompts, then recommends a focused first version.

output_examples.input: Help turn these technical notes into a plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant organizes architecture, components, data flow, error handling, and tests into validated design sections.

best_practices: Provide the project goal, known constraints, and current uncertainty.
Answer each question with enough detail to guide the next decision.
Validate each design section before moving to implementation planning.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full build before the design is validated.
Do not skip trade-off discussion when several approaches are plausible.
Do not treat the first idea as final without checking constraints.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create validated designs and specs from early ideas.

faq.question: Does it write implementation code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on discovery, design, and planning before implementation.

faq.question: Why does it ask one question at a time?
faq.answer: Single questions reduce confusion and make each design decision easier to validate.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to check project context before shaping a design.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the idea, target users, constraints, and any current project notes.

faq.question: Is it useful for nontechnical planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure product ideas, workflows, and decision points before technical details are final.
